description_en: Call the `DsgSceneQuerySceneListByName` API to retrieve a list of data masking scenarios
description_zh: 调用DsgSceneQuerySceneListByName接口，获取脱敏场景列表
name: DsgSceneQuerySceneListByName

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search of data masking scenario names
parameters.help_zh: 脱敏场景名称的模糊查询关键字，平台会根据该关键字获取相关脱敏场景信息
parameters.name: scene_name

Data.description_en: The list of data masking scenarios

items.description_en: The details of a data masking scenario

Children.description_zh: 多级脱敏场景参数信息

items.description_en: A nested (level-2) data masking scenario. The parameters for a nested scenario are the same as those for its parent
items.description_zh: 若存在多级脱敏场景（即脱敏场景存在父子节点嵌套），则此处为嵌套的脱敏场景信息。参数与外层参数相同

Desc.description_en: The description of the data masking scenario

Id.description_en: The ID of the data masking scenario

Projects.description_en: The engine instances to which the data masking scenario applies
Projects.description_zh: 脱敏场景生效的引擎信息

items.description_en: An engine instance to which the data masking scenario applies
items.description_zh: 脱敏场景生效的引擎信息

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the E-MapReduce (EMR) cluster. This parameter is returned only if the `DbType` is `EMR`
ClusterId.description_zh: EMR集群ID。仅当脱敏场景生效的数据范围为EMR引擎时，会返回该参数

DbType.description_en:
The engine type. Valid values:

MaxCompute: `ODPS.ODPS`

Hologres: `HOLO.POSTGRES`

E-MapReduce (EMR): `EMR`
DbType.description_zh:
引擎类型。取值如下：
ODPS：ODPS.ODPS
HOLO：HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR：EMR

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the engine instance

SceneCode.description_en:
The code for the level-1 scenario. Valid values:

Data masking in Data Map and DataStudio: `dataworks_display_desense_code`

Data masking at the MaxCompute engine layer: `maxcompute_desense_code`

Data masking at the MaxCompute engine layer (new): `maxcompute_new_desense_code`

Data masking at the Hologres engine layer: `hologres_display_desense_code`

Static data masking in Data Integration: `dataworks_data_integration_desense_code`

Data masking in Data Analysis: `dataworks_analysis_desense_code`
SceneCode.description_zh:
一级脱敏场景Code。取值如下：
数据开发/数据地图展示脱敏：dataworks_display_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏：maxcompute_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏（新）：maxcompute_new_desense_code
Hologres引擎层脱敏：hologres_display_desense_code
数据集成静态脱敏：dataworks_data_integration_desense_code
数据分析展示脱敏：dataworks_analysis_desense_code

SceneLevel.description_en:
The level of the data masking scenario. Valid values:

`0`: level-1 scenario

`1`: level-2 scenario
SceneLevel.description_zh:
脱敏场景级别。取值如下：
0：一级场景
1：二级场景

SceneName.description_en: The name of the data masking scenario

UserGroups.description_en: The user groups to which the data masking scenario applies. Multiple user group names are separated by a comma (,)
UserGroups.description_zh: 脱敏场景的用户组名称列表。使用英文逗号（,）隔开

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
